reason: The new integration exceeds the fixed T90 overhead tolerance; functional correctness does not close the performance gate.

provenance.settings_note: Fresh frozen-code replay and candidate use the same generated analyzer body. Project manifests differ only by the declared application/policy. The original T90 series is preserved.
provenance.excluded: excluded-debug-preflight: debug candidate vs release baseline; not acceptance data.

method.fixed_t90_tolerance_rule: max(10 percent, original T90 variation of startup runs or per-run latency medians)
method.sampling: Owned descendants only; RSS/CPU/physical I/O approximately 100 ms, complete PSS approximately 1 second. Setup and installation excluded.
method.cold: Only own copied .eska caches removed; OS caches are not flushed. Repeat uses remaining project caches.
method.comparison_order: Interleaved frozen baseline then candidate for each round; no concurrent builds or test suites.
method.provider_assertions: Hover and completion are non-empty; definition must target the actual probe function; 30 error/repair cycles complete and the module disk bytes remain unchanged. This is not an exhaustive semantic comparison of every response.

limitations: Published 0.3.2 omits diagnostic push versions; the 30 repair cycles establish these scenarios only.
End-of-scenario RSS/PSS is recorded while the primary services remain alive; no separate idle plateau was sampled.
RSS sums include shared pages more than once; PSS completeness is recorded per round.
Processes shorter than the sampling interval may be missed; physical I/O is not logical per-file I/O.
No Windows, macOS, VS Code or Remote acceptance; explicitly outside this run.
Excluded debug-candidate preflights remain archived and are not included in the summary.
End-of-scenario memory may include shutdown of other editor descendants; it is not an idle memory comparison.

baseline.scope: Final project-owned .eska caches only; no global cache claim.

reproduction.note: The reproduction variant adds only a unique output directory. It reuses these owned input copies and clears only their own .eska caches; it never modifies the user project or the original frozen baseline.

installation_sizes.note: Regular-file bytes in these local installed profiles; excludes editor, platform and filesystem allocation/shared extents. No baseline-size comparison is claimed.
